core_obligations: Noetherian source and target make f quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so f_* preserves quasi-coherence.
Represent K in D(QCoh(O_X)) by a K-injective complex I-bullet all of whose terms are injective in QCoh(O_X); set Phi(K) = f_*I-bullet.
Show the canonical map f_*I-bullet -> Rf_*I-bullet is an isomorphism: by the acyclicity lemma it suffices that each I^n is right f_*-acyclic.
Each I^n is flasque by the Noetherian injectivity lemma, and flasque sheaves are right f_*-acyclic; conclude the square commutes.
proof_roadmap: qcqs reduction; K-injective definition of Phi; acyclicity criterion; flasqueness finish.
difficulty_reason: A derived-functor extension argument chained through three named acyclicity inputs.
